title: AdS/CFT for Cosmological (de Sitter) Spacetimes
bottleneck: The holographic duality is precisely formulated only for anti-de Sitter space, while our universe appears asymptotically de Sitter — and no rigorous dS/CFT dictionary exists. Proposed versions suffer from non-unitarity, ill-defined boundaries, or lack of concrete examples. The spacelike boundary of de Sitter space and the observer-dependence of horizons obstruct a straightforward holographic dictionary.
why_it_blocks: The most successful idea in quantum gravity cannot yet describe the universe we live in. Solving it would unify holography with the cosmology we actually observe.
current_state: Research continues on static-patch holography and related proposals, but none is established; the gap is widely acknowledged. Without dS holography, the holographic principle cannot claim relevance to real cosmology. No consensus alternative to holography has emerged for de Sitter quantum gravity.
